name: Controlled response-assay procedure
objective: Measure a prespecified response against reference and vehicle controls.
context_of_use: Design review and external qualified-facility planning only.

equipment.name: Qualified liquid-handling equipment
equipment.operating_limits: Replace with validated range and facility limits.

equipment.name: Qualified measurement instrument
equipment.operating_limits: Replace with the frozen method and qualified settings.

controls.label: Reference response
controls.acceptance_criterion: Replace with the frozen facility-specific range.

controls.label: Vehicle baseline
controls.acceptance_criterion: Replace with the frozen facility-specific range.

hazards.description: Potential exposure while qualified staff handle research materials.

controls.verification: Qualified staff verify containment before work.

controls.description: Apply the approved facility procedure and authorization process.
controls.verification: Named facility reviewer confirms current approval.

hazards.emergency_response: Stop and apply the facility exposure and spill response plan.

steps.title: Prepare controlled conditions
steps.instruction: Qualified external staff prepare sample, reference, and vehicle conditions.
steps.expected_observation: All planned conditions and controls are present.
steps.acceptance_criterion: The frozen plate or vessel layout is complete.
steps.on_deviation: Stop, preserve state, and open a deviation record.
steps.risk_note: Facility-specific containment and training are required.

steps.title: Acquire frozen response
steps.instruction: Qualified external staff run the frozen measurement method.
steps.expected_observation: A complete immutable response record is produced.
steps.acceptance_criterion: Reference and vehicle controls meet frozen criteria.
steps.on_deviation: Stop interpretation and record the deviation.
steps.risk_note: No new handling is planned during acquisition.

acceptance_criteria.label: Valid controlled run
acceptance_criteria.rule: Both frozen control criteria must pass before interpretation.

stop_conditions: Containment, training, qualification, or control acceptance cannot be verified.
training_requirements: Facility-approved material handling and equipment training.
emergency_procedures: Stop work, secure the area, and follow the facility emergency plan.
waste_and_decontamination: Qualified external staff apply the facility hygiene and waste plan.
notes: Mapping previews are non-executable. Link immutable evidence and replace every placeholder before review.
